# `os` standard library

The `os` module provides safe, high-level abstractions over POSIX file descriptors,
environment variables, working-directory inspection, shell command execution, and
shell-free argument-array subprocess management with concurrent pipe I/O.

```{.dva .run}
#use io
#use os

out = os::run_args("printf", os::Args("%s-%s", "edva", "42")) | s => s | ""
io::out $ out
```

## Types and Constants

| Symbol | Kind | Definition | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `os::Args` | Growable Array | `String{}` | Argument array passed to `spawn_args`, `exec_args`, `exec_input`, `run_args`, `spawn_piped`, and `spawn_bg` |
| `os::ExecResult` | Record | `(status: Int, output: String)` | Exit status and captured stdout from `os::exec` |
| `os::ProcResult` | Record | `(status: Int, stdout: String, stderr: String)` | Exit status and separately captured `stdout` and `stderr` |
| `os::Child` | Record | `(pid: Int, stdin_fd: Int, stdout_fd: Int, stderr_fd: Int)` | Active child process handle with pipe file descriptors |
| `os::SpawnOpts` | Record | `(cwd: String, env: EnvVars, clear_env: <>)` | Working directory and environment overrides for subprocesses |
| `os::Pipe` | Record | `(r: Int, w: Int)` | Anonymous POSIX pipe read/write descriptor pair |
| `os::WinSize` | Record | `(rows: Int, cols: Int)` | Terminal/PTY window dimensions |
| `os::Pty` | Record | `(master_fd: Int, slave_fd: Int, name: String)` | Allocated pseudo-terminal master/slave pair and device path |
| `os::PtyChild` | Record | `(pid: Int, master_fd: Int, name: String)` | Interactive child process attached to a controlling PTY |
| `os::Children` | Growable Array | `Child{}` | Collection of piped child handles passed to `multiplex_children` |
| `os::ProcResults` | Growable Array | `ProcResult{}` | Multiplexed completion results returned by `multiplex_children` |
| `os::SIGINT` | Constant | `2` | Interrupt signal (`SIGINT`) |
| `os::SIGKILL` | Constant | `9` | Unconditional termination signal (`SIGKILL`) |
| `os::SIGTERM` | Constant | `15` | Graceful termination signal (`SIGTERM`) |

## Function catalog

| Category | Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Descriptors & Terminal** | `os::open(path, flags)` | `String, Int => Int` | Opens file path with flags, returning file descriptor |
| | `os::close(fd)` | `Int => Int` | Closes file descriptor |
| | `os::write(fd, buf, count)` | `Int, String, Int => Int` | Writes string byte buffer to descriptor |
| | `os::read(fd, count)` | `Int, Int => String` | Unbuffered read of up to `count` bytes into an immutable `String` |
| | `os::ioctl(fd, req, arg)` | `Int, Int, Int => Int` | Performs control device request |
| | `os::isatty(fd)` | `Int => <>` | Returns `<+>` if `fd` refers to a terminal device |
| | `os::pipe()` | `() => < Pipe | >` | Creates an anonymous POSIX pipe pair `(r, w)` |
| | `os::set_nonblocking(fd)` | `Int => <>` | Sets `O_NONBLOCK` on descriptor `fd` |
| | `os::try_read(fd, count)` | `Int, Int => < String | >` | Non-blocking read (`<+ "" +>` on `EAGAIN`, `<-->` on EOF/error) |
| **Environment** | `os::env(name)` | `String => < String | >` | Looks up environment variable `name` |
| | `os::env_or(name, fallback)` | `String, String => String` | Returns environment variable `name` or `fallback` if unset |
| | `os::setenv(name, val)` | `String, String => <>` | Sets environment variable `name` to `val` (overwriting) |
| | `os::unsetenv(name)` | `String => <>` | Removes environment variable `name` |
| **Process & Host** | `os::cwd()` | `() => String` | Returns the current working directory |
| | `os::chdir(path)` | `String => <>` | Changes the current working directory to `path` |
| | `os::pid()` | `() => Int` | Returns the current process ID |
| | `os::ppid()` | `() => Int` | Returns the parent process ID |
| | `os::hostname()` | `() => String` | Returns the system hostname |
| | `os::which(prog)` | `String => < String | >` | Searches `$PATH` for executable `prog` |
| **Subprocess (Direct `Args`)** | `os::spawn_args(prog, args)` | `String, Args => Int` | Spawns `prog` with `args` (inheriting stdio), waits, and returns exit status (`-1` on spawn failure) |
| | `os::exec_args(prog, args)` | `String, Args => < ProcResult | >` | Spawns `prog` with `args` (no shell) and captures `stdout`, `stderr`, and `status` |
| | `os::exec_input(prog, args, input)` | `String, Args, String => < ProcResult | >` | Spawns `prog` with `args`, feeds `input` to stdin, and captures `stdout`, `stderr`, and `status` |
| | `os::run_args(prog, args)` | `String, Args => < String | >` | Runs `prog` with `args` and returns `<+ stdout +>` if exit status is `0` |
| **Background & Piped Children** | `os::spawn_bg(prog, args)` | `String, Args => < Int | >` | Spawns `prog` in background (inheriting stdio) and returns `<+ child_pid +>` |
| | `os::spawn_piped(prog, args)` | `String, Args => < Child | >` | Spawns `prog` with piped `stdin_fd`, `stdout_fd`, and `stderr_fd` |
| | `os::communicate_child(child, input)` | `Child, String => < ProcResult | >` | Feeds `input` to `child`, drains stdout/stderr via `poll`, and waits for exit |
| | `os::wait_child(child)` | `Child => < ProcResult | >` | Drains remaining stdout/stderr from `child` and waits for exit |
| | `os::wait_pid(pid)` | `Int => < Int | >` | Waits for `pid` to exit and returns decoded exit code |
| | `os::try_wait_pid(pid)` | `Int => < Int | >` | Non-blocking check (`WNOHANG`); returns `<+ status +>` if exited or `<-->` if still running |
| | `os::wait_pid_timeout(pid, ms)` | `Int, Int => < Int | >` | Waits up to `ms` milliseconds for `pid` to exit (`<-->` on timeout) |
| | `os::kill_pid(pid, sig)` | `Int, Int => <>` | Sends signal `sig` to `pid` |
| | `os::spawn_opts()` | `() => SpawnOpts` | Creates default `SpawnOpts` (inherited `cwd` and environment) |
| | `os::with_cwd(opts, dir)` | `SpawnOpts, String => SpawnOpts` | Returns `SpawnOpts` with working directory `dir` |
| | `os::with_env(opts, key, val)` | `SpawnOpts, String, String => SpawnOpts` | Appends environment override `key = val` to `opts` |
| | `os::with_clear_env(opts, flag)` | `SpawnOpts, <> => SpawnOpts` | Configures whether child clears inherited environment before applying overrides |
| | `os::spawn_piped_opts(prog, args, opts)` | `String, Args, SpawnOpts => < Child | >` | Spawns `prog` with piped stdio, working directory, and environment overrides |
| | `os::spawn_bg_opts(prog, args, opts)` | `String, Args, SpawnOpts => < Int | >` | Spawns `prog` in background with `SpawnOpts` |
| | `os::exec_opts(prog, args, opts, input)` | `String, Args, SpawnOpts, String => < ProcResult | >` | Runs `prog` with `SpawnOpts` and `input`, capturing `stdout` and `stderr` |
| | `os::communicate_child_timeout(child, input, ms)` | `Child, String, Int => < ProcResult | >` | Drains `child` pipes within `ms`; sends `SIGKILL` and returns `<-->` on timeout |
| | `os::exec_timeout(prog, args, input, ms)` | `String, Args, String, Int => < ProcResult | >` | Spawns `prog` and captures output within `ms`, killing child on timeout |
| | `os::multiplex_children(children, ms)` | `Children, Int => ProcResults` | Multiplexes `stdout`/`stderr` pipes across multiple children in parallel |
| **Pseudo-Terminals (PTY)** | `os::pty_open(rows, cols)` | `Int, Int => < Pty | >` | Allocates a POSIX pseudo-terminal pair `(master_fd, slave_fd, name)` |
| | `os::pty_resize(fd, rows, cols)` | `Int, Int, Int => <>` | Updates PTY window dimensions via `TIOCSWINSZ` |
| | `os::pty_size(fd)` | `Int => < WinSize | >` | Queries PTY window dimensions via `TIOCGWINSZ` |
| | `os::spawn_pty(prog, args, rows, cols)` | `String, Args, Int, Int => < PtyChild | >` | Spawns `prog` in a new session attached to a controlling `(rows, cols)` PTY |
| | `os::spawn_pty_opts(prog, args, rows, cols, opts)` | `String, Args, Int, Int, SpawnOpts => < PtyChild | >` | Spawns `prog` in a controlling PTY with `SpawnOpts` |
| | `os::communicate_pty(pty, input, ms)` | `PtyChild, String, Int => < ExecResult | >` | Feeds `input` to `pty.master_fd`, drains PTY output within `ms`, and waits for exit |
| **Shell & Raw `posix_spawn`** | `os::system(cmd)` | `String => Int` | Runs `cmd` via `/bin/sh -c` and returns decoded exit status |
| | `os::exec(cmd)` | `String => < ExecResult | >` | Runs `cmd` via `popen` and returns `(status, output)` |
| | `os::run(cmd)` | `String => < String | >` | Runs `cmd` via `popen` and returns `<+ output +>` when status is `0` |
| | `os::spawn(path, argv)` | `String, Addr => Int` | Low-level `posix_spawn` with raw `Addr` `argv` pointer |
| **Low-Level Process Primitives** | `os::fork!` | `() => Int` | `fork(2)`: child pid in the parent, `0` in the child, negative on failure (errno set) |
| | `os::dup2(old_fd, new_fd)` | `Int, Int => <>` | `dup2(2)`: duplicates `old_fd` onto `new_fd`; `<+>` on success |
| | `os::exit_now(status)` | `Int => ()` | `_exit(2)`: terminates immediately without atexit handlers or stdio flush (use in forked children) |
| | `os::socketpair!` | `() => < (Int, Int) | >` | Connected `AF_UNIX` stream socket pair with close-on-exec set on both ends |
| | `os::set_parent_death_signal(sig)` | `Int => <>` | Linux `prctl(PR_SET_PDEATHSIG)`: deliver `sig` when the parent exits; always `<->` on other platforms |

## Usage examples

### Capturing stdout, stderr, and feeding stdin without shell injection

```{.dva .run}
#use io
#use os

res = os::exec_input("tr", os::Args("a-z", "A-Z"), "hello edva")
res
   | r => io::out $ r.stdout
   | io::out $ "failed"
```

### Working directory, environment overrides, and parallel process multiplexing

```{.dva .run}
#use io
#use os

opts = os::with_env(os::with_cwd(os::spawn_opts!, "/tmp"), "EDVA_MODE", "fast")
c0 = os::spawn_piped_opts("sh", os::Args("-c", "printf '%s' \"$EDVA_MODE\""), opts)!!
c1 = os::spawn_piped("printf", os::Args("parallel-ok"))!!

results = os::multiplex_children(os::Children(c0, c1), 2000)
io::out $ (results(0)!!).stdout + ":" + (results(1)!!).stdout
```
